Our Workflow

A Structured, High-Performance Design Journey

From initial conceptual maps in Figma to live production deployment, we maintain absolute transparency and quality verification at every step.

01. Discovery & Strategy

We define your target goals, audit current assets, analyze competitors, and plan out structural maps.

02. Research & Planning

We map user journeys, research high-ranking search keywords, and establish layout strategy blueprints.

03. Wireframing & UX

We map out low-fidelity UX wireframes to establish logical site structure and user conversion flows.

04. High-Fidelity UI Design

We craft custom, modern UI layouts in Figma featuring sleek gradients, modern typography, and glassmorphism.

05. Production Coding

We convert approved Figma designs into clean, fast, and semantic Next.js or React code architectures.

06. Performance & QA

We run rigorous checks for mobile response, cross-browser compatibility, security compliance, and speed.

07. Domain & Launch

We map your custom DNS configurations, set up Vercel or AWS server deployments, and launch live.

08. Support & Iteration

We provide monthly updates, database backups, security patches, and site modifications to scale results.
